featured_reviews.review_text: Vidya, the store manager...was remarkable.she understood my needs, and provided the necessary medicines. My requirements were not straightforward and yet she went out of the way and I got all what I wanted. This is because of her who nicest understood my needs.

featured_reviews.name: Mugdha Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Most horrible Wellness ever. Went there to buy basic snacks. Was in a hurry since a rickshaw was waiting for me. The total was around 250-300, the lady on the counter gave 100 rs less also the 100 rs note she gave was torn. Since was in a hurry I didn't notice but saw it once I reached home. They're just scamming people and looting them. Horrible staff. Will complain in consumer court.

featured_reviews.name: Olly Esse
featured_reviews.review_text: Went there several times. Last one was HUMILIATING. I go there with the prescription. Addressing one person at the counter. He goes away with my phone in his hand on the back side (weird), then comes back laughing. Then some girl comes by and looks at the prescription, then the other one just out of curiosity. Then another girl, then another person. Basically in 5 they tried to have fun on my expenses. I felt so bad I didn't knew how to act, because for me a pharmacist has to provide PRIVACY not laugh at someone's illnesses. I asked for more units of one pill and he - the guy who served, was on the phone. Once done I asked for an activated charcoal since at this point I was surrounded by whole staff as I would be some circus clown. No one knew if they have it. Why so many people working there if no one is trained or professional. If ur a woman, don't go there. I don't want anyone to be treated so poorly.

featured_reviews.review_text: If we purchase even 1 medicine from  any medical  they atleast give 10%discount but here they only give discount when the product is above 500.and the staff is also very careless often they make mistakes in the bill .
